current_test_set.label: Current student test set
current_test_set.summary: These are the open-divider worksheets with the newer large answer boxes and notch-style center guide marks. They are now both the classroom test packet and the default public Grade 2 worksheets. Use these for the next classroom handwriting samples. Intake instructions are in docs/STUDENT_SAMPLE_INTAKE.md.

default_public_note: As of 2026-05-30, the default public Grade 2 A/B/C worksheet SVGs, layout JSON, and printable PDFs were promoted to the open/notch divider answer boxes. The separate open-divider-test URLs remain useful as explicit classroom-test links, but they should visually match the default public worksheets.

design_evidence.label: Answer box option gallery
design_evidence.summary: Comparison gallery showing the answer-box variants that led to the current open-divider choice. This is design evidence, not the packet Tony should print for the student handwriting test.
